summary.zh: 判断自研还是调用 API，评估 AI 合规风险
summary.en: Decide build vs buy, classify risk, weigh self-hosting

description.zh: 协助判断 AI 能力该调用 API、微调还是自建，评估 EU AI Act 与美国州级法规的风险等级，并测算自托管成本、给出 AI 团队招聘顺序。适合制定 AI 战略或评审一个 AI 项目方案时使用。
description.en: Helps decide whether to call an API, fine-tune or build in-house, classifies regulatory risk under the EU AI Act and US state rules, and weighs self-hosting costs and AI hiring order. Use it for AI strategy calls.
